slug: 2025-01-01 Sierra Leone Government Service Bus prototype - Terms of Reference (World Bank)

facts.fact: The World Bank's terms of reference say a Japan QII grant signed on 26 April 2025 funds a Government Service Bus prototype on an open-source platform such as X-Road, hosted in the Ministry of Finance data centre, to link PFM systems including IFMIS, ITAS, ASYCUDA and CRVS.
The terms of reference say there is no government service bus with agreed protocols within the PFM ecosystem and the systems operate standalone (date is the document's published year).

SLE.note: No system checking people against a national ID is stated; CRVS is named only as a system to interconnect.

systems.country_label: ASYCUDA World system of the Customs Department

SLE.note: Names the customs system but does not state that declarations are lodged or processed in it, or that it is under way.
Names ITAS as launched but does not state online filing, electronic payment or uptake.
